summary:
The name of this bill is the "National Defence University Act, 2083" (Section 1, Subsection 1, Page 1). Its main purpose is to establish and operate the National Defence University as a specialised academic centre for high-level study, teaching, and research in national security, defence, international relations, and strategic subjects to produce skilled, qualified, capable, and responsible human resources capable of contributing to the protection, promotion, and advancement of national interests (Preamble, Page 1; Section 3, Subsection 1, Page 2). This Act shall come into force on the thirty-first day from the date of authentication (Section 1, Subsection 2, Page 1).

The Executive Council shall coordinate with the Government of Nepal, Provincial Government, and Local Level as necessary to run the university in an organised manner (Section 13, Subsection 1, Clause d, Subclause 3, Page 9). The University must obtain the approval of the Government of Nepal, Council of Ministers before selling or transferring the title of immovable property by any other means (Section 4, Subsection 3, Page 2). The organizational structure and academic and administrative staff positions of the University shall be as approved by the Government of Nepal, Council of Ministers (Section 17, Subsection 1, Page 11). The Government of Nepal may depute employees from the civil service of the Government of Nepal, the Nepali Army, and other government services on deputation for the operation of the University upon the request of the Executive Council (Section 17, Subsection 3, Page 11). The Government of Nepal, Council of Ministers shall depute the Commandant, who acts as the head for the operation and management of the college, from among the serving Major Generals of the Nepali Army on the recommendation of the Chief of Army Staff (Section 27, Subsections 1 and 2, Page 16). If the University cannot be operated due to any reason, the Government of Nepal may dissolve the University on the recommendation of the Senate (Section 44, Subsection 1, Page 20). The University shall make coordination and contact with the Government of Nepal through the Ministry (Section 43, Page 20).

The University may grant affiliation to the Nepali Army Command and Staff College, Nepali Army War College, Nepali Military Academy, Armed Police Force, Nepal, Command and Staff College, Nepal Police Staff College, or other educational institutions of security bodies that fulfill the prescribed conditions and standards (Section 37, Page 19). The University shall grant certificates and degrees as prescribed to students, trainees, or researchers who complete their studies, and may grant honorary degrees to persons who perform remarkable work in research and academic fields or to distinguished persons of national and international repute (Section 38, Subsections 1 and 2, Page 19). Provisions regarding the examination system and curriculum of the University shall be as prescribed (Section 39, Page 20). The Institute of Defence Studies shall ensure the quality of programs conducted under it (Section 14, Subsection 2, Clause d, Page 10). The National Defence College shall maintain the quality of educational programs conducted by it in accordance with the educational policy and curriculum of the University (Section 28, Clause c, Page 16). The Strategic Studies Research Centre shall set necessary standards for determining the quality of research conducted by the Centre (Section 30, Clause c, Page 17).

The bill establishes the National Defence University as an autonomous, self-governing, corporate body with perpetual succession as a specialised academic centre for high-level study, teaching, and research in national security, defence, international relations, and strategic subjects, with its central office located at Perungedanda, Banepa Municipality, Kavrepalanchok District, Bagmati Province (Section 3, Subsections 1 and 3, Page 2; Section 4, Subsection 1, Page 2). The Senate serves as the supreme body of the University, chaired by the Prime Minister as Chancellor, with the Defence Minister as Co-Chair and the Registrar as Member-Secretary (Section 7, Subsections 1 and 2, Pages 3-4). An Executive Council headed by the Vice-Chancellor acts as the executive body of the University (Section 12, Subsection 1, Page 8). The Vice-Chancellor acts as the executive head of the University (Section 20, Subsection 1, Page 12; Section 21, Page 13). The Chancellor shall appoint the Vice-Chancellor and the Registrar from among three potential candidates recommended through open competition by a recommendation committee chaired by the Chief of Army Staff, with one member nominated from the Academic Council and the Director General of Military Training as Member-Secretary, and the committee must make the recommendation within two months of its formation (Section 24, Subsections 1, 2, 3, and 5, Pages 14-15). The University shall have a separate fund consisting of amounts received from the Government of Nepal, amounts received from the University Grants Commission, amounts received from study, training, research, educational fees or service fees, and amounts received from any person or organisation, and these funds shall be deposited in an account opened at a Class A commercial bank (Section 35, Subsections 1, 2, and 3, Pages 18-19).

This Act repeals the "National Defence University Infrastructure Construction Development Committee (Formation) Order, 2076" (Section 49, Subsection 1, Page 21). All movable and immovable assets and liabilities in the name of the repealed National Defence University Infrastructure Construction Development Committee shall be deemed transferred to the University, and actions taken pursuant to that formation order shall be deemed to have been taken under this Act (Section 49, Subsections 2 and 3, Page 21).
